title: Mupane Gold Mine employee wage and bonus dispute
date: December 2021–January 2022 (planned strike reported; actual stoppage disputed)
reason: The demands concerned salary increases and annual bonuses from a private mine employer. The available reports do not establish a domestic state-policy demand or a public gathering. The codebook excludes a private-industry wage strike without state-policy involvement.
notes: The 111 employees/BMWU members are a workforce or union-membership figure, not attendance. The 31 January Sunday Standard story has one sentence saying a strike was initiated but quotes the union secretary describing preparation and mediation to avert a looming strike. The 17 December Mmegi excerpt says no strike could occur during a cooling-off period and workers were being mobilized for a planned action, then reaches a paywall. This status conflict does not alter the private-employer/no-public-gathering boundary.

title: UDC letter demanding withdrawal of supplementary voter registration notice
date: January 2022 (exact letter date unknown; IEC response deadline stated as 18 January)
reason: The January Gazette reports a state-directed electoral-process demand made by letter to the IEC and a threatened legal challenge, not a public gathering. No participant turnout is described.
notes: Read in the 19 January issue, printed p.5. This political-process lead is recorded independently from the student allowance petition and the private Mupane labor dispute.
